text_block_list.text: One day, while walking on the academy grounds—

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Well then, please!
......

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I see.
So your musica is... like this!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
That special skill~~ My curiosity just won't stop~♪
Go ahead~~ try reading my mind~~♪

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Wah!? Amazing!
You guessed it!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I was merely listening to the
melodia within their hearts.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I heard Earth-san can hear other people's hearts as music!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Whether humans, horse girls, or even speechless plants,
they all play music through their expressions and gestures.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
In other words, everything in this world—
every single thing can be called an instrument!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Well then, well then!
Please let it be my turn next!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Heave-hooo!!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
So much fun, so much fun~♪
Heave-ho~~♪

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Whoa!! That's a hit!
choice_data_list: ...You kinda just blurted out the answer, you know?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Earth-san, what kind of mood is that kitty over there in?

text_block_list.name: Cat
text_block_list.text: Nyaa~, nyaa~.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Under the chin~♪ Under the chin~♪
Scratch me right under the chin, meow~♪

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
...Oops, quiet down.
I hear a melody coming from somewhere...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...*sigh*

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I'm nowhere near my target time...
...And the mock race is coming up so soon...

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
So it was you...
The musicista who plays this melody.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Earth-san...?
Um, did you need something... from me?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"Rather, it was you who called for me.
With the melodia overflowing from your heart, that is."

It seems Sounds of Earth rushed over, sensing her depressed mood...
Or so I thought, but—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Aah~♪ Burning passions, blazing bright~♪
Falling down or hitting a wall, it burns on evermore~♪

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Wha...!? What's this all of a sudden...!?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Che passione!!
This is the musica from deep within you!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
At first glance, it's just a battered instrument case...
Yet from the instrument within,
a passionate, boiling melody can be heard!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Passionate... a boiling melody...

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Why not lend an ear?
To the con fuoco musica played by your true feelings.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: My true feelings... Yeah, that's right. I was so far from my goal... that I started to hate it all...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...Still, there's still time!
I'll do even more until then!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: I'm definitely not giving up...!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: "Benissimo! Music always conveys one's feelings straight from the heart!"
choice_data_list: You could hear what she was truly feeling.
You could hear her true feelings

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Sì! One's true feelings are easy to lose sight of.
Which is precisely why I shall play them!
choice_data_list: What kind of 'music' do you hear from within yourself?
What kind of 'music' comes from within you?
You really look out for your juniors, huh.
You really look out for your juniors, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Sì! One's true feelings are easy to lose sight of.
Which is precisely why I shall play them!
choice_data_list: What kind of 'music' do you hear from within yourself?
What kind of 'music' comes from within you?
You really look out for your juniors, huh.
You really look out for your juniors, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Oho, you wish to know?
Then behold!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
This is completely filled with scores!
No matter how much I write, I can't keep up with all my ideas—that's who I am right now!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
That's right!
Let's keep playing a Musica vast enough to cover the Earth!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Because they're lovely musicistas
who play such fresh and lively music!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
And when I talk with Cheval...
I feel like I can hear a grand musica
playing from somewhere far away.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Playing an ensemble with her
promises to be a delightful experience!
